summary: Filesystem reorganization: moved repos that had accumulated directly in ~ into ~/repos/ (which maps to /mnt/repos_drive/projects/), then created backward-compat symlinks at the original ~ paths for existing cron jobs and skills.
highlights: Moved 6 git repos from ~ to ~/repos/ (physical: /mnt/repos_drive/projects/); created ~/repo-name symlinks pointing back for backward compat with existing crons/skills
Established hard rule: all new repos go in ~/repos/ (personal) or ~/repos/work/ (work), never directly in ~; ~ symlinks to be pruned as scripts are updated
